problems.quote: Chandragupta Maurya, who was later succeeded by Ashoka
problems.problem: Chandragupta Maurya was succeeded by his son Bindusara; Ashoka was Bindusara's son and succeeded him, not Chandragupta directly.
problems.correction: Chandragupta Maurya, who was later succeeded by Bindusara and then Ashoka
problems.verifierReason: Original skips Bindusara; correction accurately includes him.

problems.quote: G20 is a forum of 19 countries plus the EU
problems.problem: Outdated composition: since September 2023 the African Union is also a permanent member, making it 19 countries + EU + AU.
problems.correction: G20 is a forum of 19 countries plus the EU and the African Union
problems.verifierReason: African Union admitted as permanent member at Sep 2023 G20 summit; original quote outdated, correction accurate.

problems.quote: Lok Sabha has a maximum strength of 543 elected members
problems.problem: The constitutional maximum strength of Lok Sabha is 550 elected members (530 from states + 20 from UTs). 543 is the current sanctioned strength, not the maximum.
problems.correction: Lok Sabha has a current strength of 543 elected members
problems.verifierReason: Constitutional max is 550 (Art 81: 530 states + 20 UTs); 543 is current sanctioned strength. Correction is accurate.

problems.quote: Para Olympics
problems.problem: Incorrect name for the event; official name is Paralympic Games
problems.correction: Paralympic Games
problems.verifierReason: Official name is Paralympic Games; Para Olympics is incorrect

problems.quote: 2003 adoption of a Super Eight stage
problems.problem: Super Eight stage was introduced in 2007, not 2003
problems.correction: 2007 adoption of a Super Eight stage
problems.verifierReason: Super Eight debuted at 2007 Cricket World Cup; 2003 used Super Six

problems.quote: 2015 decision to revert to a straight knockout after a single group phase
problems.problem: 2015 World Cup used two groups then knockout; single group phase was introduced in 2019
problems.correction: 2019 introduction of a single group phase followed by knockout
problems.verifierReason: 2015 WC had two groups then quarters; single group phase began in 2019

problems.quote: Note that Kangchenjunga is not in India but on the border; the highest peak entirely within Indian territory is Nanda Devi.
problems.problem: Kanchenjunga lies on the India–Nepal border, so it is in India; stating it is not in India is false.
problems.correction: Kangchenjunga lies on the India–Nepal border, making it the highest peak in India; the highest peak entirely within Indian territory is Nanda Devi.
problems.verifierReason: Kangchenjunga is on the India-Nepal border, so it is in India; the correction accurately states it is the highest peak in India and Nanda Devi is highest entirely within India.

problems.quote: Kanchenjunga (8,598 m)
problems.problem: The elevation of Kanchenjunga is 8,586 m, not 8,598 m.
problems.correction: Kanchenjunga (8,586 m)
problems.verifierReason: Accepted elevation of Kangchenjunga is 8,586 m; 8,598 m is incorrect.

problems.quote: Kanchenjunga is in Sikkim, but Kangchenjunga is on the border with Nepal.
problems.problem: Kanchenjunga and Kangchenjunga are the same peak; it lies on the Sikkim–Nepal border.
problems.correction: Kanchenjunga (Kangchenjunga) lies on the Sikkim–Nepal border.
problems.verifierReason: Kanchenjunga and Kangchenjunga are alternative spellings of the same peak on the Sikkim-Nepal border; original falsely treats them as separate.

problems.quote: originally developed for tennis line‑calling
problems.problem: Hawk‑Eye was first developed for cricket broadcast analysis (2001), not for tennis line‑calling.
problems.correction: originally developed for cricket broadcast analysis
problems.verifierReason: Hawk-Eye first used in cricket (2001), not tennis; correction accurate.

problems.quote: established in 1984 under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
problems.problem: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports was created in 2000; SAI was established under the Department of Youth Affairs and Sports (then under Ministry of Human Resource Development).
problems.correction: established in 1984 under the Department of Youth Affairs and Sports
problems.verifierReason: SAI founded 1984 under Dept of Youth Affairs & Sports, not Ministry (created 2000).

problems.quote: The Khelo India programme, launched in 2018
problems.problem: The Khelo India programme was launched in 2017; the first Khelo India School Games were held in 2018.
problems.correction: The Khelo India programme, launched in 2017
problems.verifierReason: Khelo India programme launched 2017; first games 2018; correction correct.

problems.quote: The overall percentage decrease is 1 − (1 − d/100)ⁿ.
problems.problem: The formula gives the fractional decrease, not the percentage decrease; to express as a percentage it must be multiplied by 100.
problems.correction: The overall percentage decrease is [1 − (1 − d/100)ⁿ] × 100%.
problems.verifierReason: Original gives fractional decrease; correction multiplies by 100% per standard percentage notation.

problems.quote: Equating P (1 + r/100)ⁿ = P (1 + R/100)ⁿ (where R is the simple rate per period)
problems.problem: The equation uses the compound interest formula for simple interest; simple interest formula is P(1 + nR/100).
problems.correction: Equating P(1+r/100)ⁿ = P(1+nR/100) (where R is the simple annual rate)
problems.verifierReason: Original uses compound formula for simple interest; correction uses correct simple interest formula with annual rate.

problems.quote: the addend 6 comes from the sum of those primes
problems.problem: The sum of the distinct prime factors of 12 (2 and 3) is 5, not 6.
problems.correction: the addend 5 comes from the sum of those primes
problems.verifierReason: Sum of distinct prime factors of 12 is 5, not 6; correction accurate.

problems.quote: within the same biological kingdom (plant vs insect)
problems.problem: Plants (kingdom Plantae) and insects (kingdom Animalia) belong to different biological kingdoms, not the same kingdom.
problems.correction: across biological kingdoms (plant vs insect)
problems.verifierReason: Plants and insects are different kingdoms; correction fixes error.

problems.quote: CAT → DDU
problems.problem: The example claims a +1 letter shift, but CAT→DDU is not a uniform +1 shift (C→D +1, A→D +3, T→U +1).
problems.correction: CAT → DBU
problems.verifierReason: Original CAT→DDU not uniform +1; correction CAT→DBU is correct uniform +1 shift.

problems.quote: Recognising a recursive pattern requires computing successive differences and checking whether the differences themselves follow a known series.
problems.problem: Finite differences identify polynomial sequences, not recursive series; recursive patterns are detected via recurrence relations, not difference tables.
problems.correction: Recognising a recursive pattern requires identifying a recurrence relation (e.g., T_n = a·T_{n-1} + b·T_{n-2}), not finite differences.
problems.verifierReason: Original confuses finite differences (polynomial tool) with recurrence relations (recursive definition). Correction accurately states recursive patterns are identified via recurrence relations.

problems.quote: climbs a ladder 5 m high leaning against a wall at 60° to the ground
problems.problem: The phrase "5 m high" means the vertical height reached is 5 m, but the solution incorrectly uses 5 m as the ladder length (hypotenuse) to compute horizontal projection as 5·cos 60°.
problems.correction: climbs a ladder 5 m long leaning against a wall at 60° to the ground
problems.verifierReason: Original '5 m high' ambiguous; 'high' suggests vertical height, but solution uses as ladder length. Correction '5 m long' fixes ambiguity.

problems.quote: Acids (pH 7) — bitter, turn red litmus blue, examples: NaOH, Ca(OH)₂, NH₄OH.
problems.problem: Incorrectly describes bases as acids; acids have pH < 7, are sour, turn blue litmus red, while bases have pH > 7, are bitter, turn red litmus blue.
problems.correction: Bases (pH > 7) — bitter, turn red litmus blue, examples: NaOH, Ca(OH)₂, NH₄OH.
problems.verifierReason: Original mislabels bases as acids; correction correctly describes bases with pH>7, bitter, red litmus blue.

problems.quote: The first ionisation energy of Cr is slightly lower than that of V because the removed electron comes from the 4s orbital, leaving a stable 3d⁵ core.
problems.problem: The first ionization energy of Cr (652.9 kJ/mol) is actually slightly higher than that of V (650.9 kJ/mol), not lower.
problems.correction: The first ionisation energy of Cr is slightly higher than that of V.
problems.verifierReason: Original claims Cr IE lower than V; actual values show Cr IE slightly higher; correction is accurate.

problems.quote: Strong acids have Ka ≫ 1 (pKa 0).
problems.problem: Strong acids have pKa < 0, not pKa = 0.
problems.correction: Strong acids have Ka ≫ 1 (pKa < 0).
problems.verifierReason: Original states pKa=0 for strong acids; strong acids have pKa<0; correction is accurate.

problems.quote: the report in which she referred
problems.problem: Collocation error: 'refer' takes 'to', not 'in'; the correct prepositional phrase is 'to which she referred' or 'which she referred to'
problems.correction: the report to which she referred
problems.verifierReason: Original has collocation error: 'refer' requires 'to'. Correction 'to which she referred' is grammatically correct.

problems.quote: IRDAI Act, 1999
problems.problem: The Act is officially named the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999, not "IRDAI Act".
problems.correction: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999
problems.verifierReason: Official name is Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999; correction is accurate.

problems.quote: enactment of the Data Protection Bill (under consideration)
problems.problem: The Data Protection Bill was enacted as the Digital Personal Data Protection Act in August 2023; it is no longer under consideration.
problems.correction: enactment of the Data Protection Bill (now the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023)
problems.verifierReason: Bill enacted as Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023; correction accurate.

problems.quote: historic gold medal in men’s hockey at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics

problems.correction: historic bronze medal in men’s hockey at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics
problems.verifierReason: India won bronze, not gold, in men's hockey at Tokyo 2020; correction correct.
